# Design Systems Assistant MCP

> A curated, machine-readable design systems knowledge base served over the
> Model Context Protocol. 240+ vetted entries: W3C/WCAG standards, major
> design system documentation, practitioner best practices, and — the part
> most model training lacks — the 2025-2026 agent-interface protocols
> (A2UI, MCP Apps, AG-UI), component contracts, and AI-and-design-systems
> practice. Maintained by Southleft (southleft.com).

Connect any MCP client to https://design-systems-mcp.southleft.com/mcp
(Streamable HTTP, no authentication). An SSE endpoint exists at /sse for
older clients.

Tools exposed:

- search_design_knowledge: full-text + vector search over entries, with
  category and tag filters. Returns nothing rather than adjacent content
  when a topic is not covered.
- search_chunks: passage-level search for the specific text that answers
  a question.
- browse_by_category: list entries in a category (accessibility,
  components, documentation, general, guidelines, patterns, quality,
  tokens, tools, variables).
- browse_by_tag: list entries carrying a tag.
- get_all_tags: enumerate all tags.

## Content coverage

- Standards: WCAG 2.1/2.2, WCAG 3.0 draft, ARIA APG, DTCG token spec
- Major design systems: guidance-layer documentation, not prop tables
- Agent-interface protocols: A2UI v1.0, MCP Apps (SEP-1865), AG-UI,
  server-driven UI lineage
- Practice: component contracts, source-of-truth debate, Context-Based
  Design Systems, naming for agents, machine-readable documentation,
  design system evals
- AI tooling: how Lovable, v0, Figma Make, Replit, Claude Code, Copilot,
  Cursor, and Windsurf each ingest a design system

## Optional

- [Repository](https://github.com/southleft/design-systems-mcp): source,
  ingestion pipeline, and eval harness
- [Southleft](https://southleft.com): the agency behind this server
- [Slot Machine](https://southleft.substack.com): TJ Pitre's writing on
  AI and design systems, much of it primary source material here
